# Atlas Univerziteta

Atlas Univerziteta is a free, open-source directory of universities, faculties, and study programs (with their tracks) in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The site provides a searchable web interface and a public REST API.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/)
- [Search](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/search)
- [About](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/about)
- [API Docs](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/api-docs)

## API access

- [API root and discovery](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/)
- [All universities endpoint](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/api/v1/universities)
- [University by id endpoint](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/api/v1/universities/1)
- [Unified search endpoint (universities, faculties, study programs; supports searchTerm, entity, ownership, cycle and type filters)](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/api/v1/search?searchTerm=sarajevo)

The search matches names, cities, acronyms, ECTS/duration values, and related unit names, case- and diacritic-insensitively, with tolerance for Bosnian/Croatian/Serbian inflected word forms.
